items.title: Sonny Rollins — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember I was playing with uh...the great Dizzy Gillespie over at Wolf Trap... And uh, we were doing this big tribute concert to Dizzy, and I think in the band was the great Hank Jones, Dizzy, myself, I think was Mickey Roker and Rufus Reid.

ctx.x: Did you see any of the “Battle of the Bands?”

Uh, no. I went to, when I went to The Savoy, I went there, Dizzy Gillespie was there. And that was uh we were really into Dizzy, so, I was still fairly young. I was in my uh early teens, you know, when I went to The Savoy, and it wasn’t long after that The Savoy uh closed, you know. So, I didn’t see these “Battle of the Bands,” but I heard a lot about them, but I didn’t witness them myself.
Was it expensive to go these theaters or the clubs?
